title: Grant Builds With AI
tagline: A middle aged guy building real things with AI, one project at a time.
about: Building things with AI turned into my new hobby. I'm not a professional developer. I'm a regular guy who picks a real project, figures out how to build it with AI tools, and then tells you how it went.

Every episode is one project in 10 to 30 minutes: what I tried to build, what went wrong, and how it turned out. You'll hear which tools I used, what they were good at, and which parts I still had to do by hand.

After an episode, you'll sometimes get a bonus called Claude's Take. Claude, the AI I build most of these projects with, reads the episode's transcript and answers back in a short segment, read in an AI voice: what I left out, what it would have done differently, and where it thinks I got it wrong.
Some episodes come with a how-to guide. It's a roadmap for building the same thing yourself with an AI helping you.

guides.title: Build Your Own App with AI
guides.summary: How I built GBc̄Ai, an Android app and website, without being a developer. The accounts you'll set up yourself, a workshop design that grows with you, a real AI build with a spending cap, and the path through Google Play testing. No code: your AI helper writes it with you, and a Word version to download.

guides.title: Build Your Own AI Dungeon Master for Discord
guides.summary: A beginner's roadmap, and the companion to Episodes 1 and 2. It covers the accounts and setup you'll do yourself, then the ten steps to a bot that runs a D&D campaign in Discord around the clock. No code: your AI tutor writes it with you.

guides.title: Deploy Your Own AI Research Agent on Google Cloud
guides.summary: The companion to Episode 4. Copy Google's Deep Search agent into your own Google Cloud account, avoid the setting that bills you around the clock, and build a small tool that saves its cited reports as Word documents. Includes a real report to read. No code: your AI helper writes it with you.

guides.title: Make a Printed Book for Your Family with AI
guides.summary: The companion to Episode 5. Turn the rough notes in a Google Doc into a real printed book, with AI as your editor, co-writer and typesetter. Covers the editor's questions to ask, shaping chapters into a book, print-ready files, ordering, and a new edition every year. No code, and a Word version to download.

guides.title: Build Your Own AI Investment Research Team
guides.summary: The companion to Episode 6. Take Google's sample Financial Advisor agent apart, give it official SEC filings, and re-staff it as a team of two AIs: Gemini does the research, and Claude does the analysis and fact-checks Gemini. Includes two real reports and what each one cost. Educational, not investment advice. No code: your AI helper writes it with you.

reports_note: Two real reports from the agent, exactly as it produced them. Gemini did the research and Claude checked it, and each report lists the errors Claude found. They were tests of the tool, based on public filings as of 30 September 2026. They're educational, not investment advice.

reports.title: Costco (COST): Long-Term Investment Research
reports.summary: The first report from the two-AI team. A steady business with a steep price. Claude caught a stale dividend and some optimistic return math in Gemini's scenario.

reports.title: Hims & Hers Health (HIMS): Long-Term Investment Research
reports.summary: The stress test. Gemini's summary missed a federal lawsuit and reported about $1 billion of debt as zero. Claude found both in the filings.

reports.title: 12-Week Home Ski Prep Plan
reports.summary: The plan Muse built: resistance bands only, about seven minutes a day, in three phases with a taper at the end. It includes knee safety rules and links to 15 form videos.
reports.heading: Get the plan
reports.note: The full training plan from this episode, exactly as Muse made it. It's general fitness prep, not medical advice. If you have a knee or joint history, check with your doctor or physio first.
